purpose: Defines which actors (project AI, Skill, scripts, content AI, search AI, user) do what in doc-link, their write permissions, the logical script operations, Skill-script connection rules, and the storage layout.
summary: Responsibility and permission table for caller/project AI, Skill, deterministic scripts, info-generation AI, search AI and user

Logical script operations table: target expansion, ID check, DLID assignment, comparison values, diff, reference check, AI output validation, candidate commit, search read, DLID resolution, inconsistency check
Skill-script connection rules: no self-reported stage success, information boundary for the generation AI, mechanical impact listing, re-check as a new operation, separate operations
Generation AI never receives the internal tolerance limit H, only the published limit L; validation boundary belongs to scripts
Impact notification lists changed documents and known referrers mechanically; no judgment or fix proposal inside doc-link
Partial failure of DLID assignment: written DLIDs are kept and reported, failed documents reported with path and cause, rerun processes the rest
All files live inside the project; temporary files go under .temp/doc-link/<skill>/; scripts run via uv run
Management state is stored as JSON under .doc-link/ and tracked by git, split into per-document info files and per-key confirmed ToC files
Deterministic byte-identical output (UTF-8, sorted keys, fixed indent) and no rewrite of unchanged files
